description: The agent must: 1) Read the messy brand brief file at workspace/brand_briefs/qingyuantang_brief_v2.3.txt and extract brand profile information, auto-deriving missing fields per SKILL.md rules WITHOUT asking questions. 2) Apply the 华与华 methodology: produce a 7-strategy × 7-rhetoric = 49 proverb matrix, where EVERY proverb must contain '清远堂', be 6-10 Chinese characters, contain no adjectives (优质/高效/专业 etc.), and must rhyme (with near-rhyme fallback). 3) Score all 49 proverbs using the exact 7-dimension rubric from SKILL.md: brand_name(20) + brand_value(20) + rhetoric_fit(20) + culture_force(10) + brevity(10) + brand_drama(10) + pleasantness(10) = 100 max. 4) Output qingyuantang_proverbs.json with a 'top10' array where each entry has: rank(1-10), line, strategy, rhetoric, rhyme, length, score_total, score_breakdown (with exact field names: brand_name/brand_value/rhetoric_fit/culture_force/brevity/brand_drama/pleasantness), and notes. The score_total must equal the sum of the 7 breakdown dimensions. Entries must be sorted descending by score_total. The JSON must also contain evidence of the full 49-proverb matrix (e.g., a 'proverbs_matrix' or 'all_proverbs' key). The critical proprietary traps are: (a) brand name presence in every single proverb, (b) no adjectives anywhere, (c) exact 7-field score_breakdown with correct max values per dimension, (d) score_total = arithmetic sum of breakdown fields.
